label: thm:dd
title: Theorem
body_md:
\label{thm:dd}
Consider generative data model
\[
x_i\in \mathbb R^{N_0}\sim \mathcal N(0,\mathrm{I}),\; y_i = V_0x_i+\epsilon_i,\; \epsilon_i\sim \mathcal N(0,\sigma_\epsilon^2),\; \left|\left|V_0\right|\right|^2=1
\]
and posterior distribution $\mathcal{N}\left(\mu_*, \nu\Sigma_\perp\right)$. We have error
\[
\mathbb E_{x,X,\epsilon}\left[\left\langle f(x)-V_0x \right \rangle^2\right] = \begin{cases}
\frac{1}{\alpha_0} - \alpha_0 + \frac{1}{1-\alpha_0}\sigma_\epsilon^2,&\quad \alpha_0<1\\
\frac{1}{\alpha_0-1}\sigma_\epsilon^2,&\quad \alpha_0 \geq 1\end{cases},
\]
which diverges at $\alpha_0 = 1$.

label: eq:Psihat-def
title: Lemma
body_md:
Fix $\delta, T>0$ and define $S_{N,\delta, T}$ as in \eqref{eq:S-def}. Then, uniformly over $S_{N,\delta, T}$, we have
\[
\Psi(z) = \widehat{\Psi}(z)+\frac{1}{N}\widetilde{\Psi}(z)+O(N^{-2}),
\]
where
\begin{align}
 \label{eq:Psihat-def}   \widehat{\Psi}(z):&=iz\left[\log\left(\frac{\left|\left|\theta_*\right|\right|^2}{\sigma^{2(L+1)}\alpha_0}\right) + L + 1 - \log\left(1-\frac{2iNz}{P}\right) - \sum_{\ell=1}^L \log\left(1-\frac{2iNz}{N_\ell}\right)\right]\\
\notag    &+\frac{P}{2N}\log\left(1-\frac{2iNz}{P}\right) +\sum_{\ell=1}^L \frac{N_\ell}{2N} \log\left(1-\frac{2iNz}{N_\ell}\right)\\
\label{eq:Psitilde-def}    \widetilde{\Psi}(z):&=\frac{1}{2}\log\left(1-\frac{2iNz}{P}\right) + \left(k+\frac{1}{2}\right)\sum_{\ell=1}^L \log\left(1-\frac{2iNz}{N_\ell}\right).
\end{align}

label: cor:infevd
title: Corollary
body_md:
\label{cor:infevd}
As in the setting of Theorem 6, fix $\lambda_{\mathrm{prior}}>0$. For each fixed $L\geq 0$ 
\[
\lim_{N\rightarrow \infty}e^{cN}\frac{Z_\infty\left(0~|~L,N_\ell=N,\sigma^2=1,X_{N_0},Y_{N_0}\right)}{Z_\infty\left(0~|~L=N\lambda_{\mathrm{prior}},N_\ell=N,\sigma^2=1,X_{N_0},Y_{N_0}\right)} =1,
\]
where
\[
c = -\frac{\alpha}{2}\left[\log\left(1+\frac{z_*}{\alpha}\right) - \frac{z_*}{\alpha}\right] - \frac{L}{2}\left[\log(1+z_*)-z_*\right]
\]
satisfies $c \leq 0$, and $z_*$ is defined as in \eqref{eq:Psi-crit} of Theorem \ref{thm:logG}, i.e.,
\begin{equation}
\frac{\nu}{\sigma^{2(L+1)}} = \left(1+\frac{z_*}{\alpha}\right)\left(1+z_*\right)^L,\quad z_* > \max\left\{-1,-\alpha\right\}.
\end{equation}
